messages:
Lina: morning — Midtown Health day0 gatecheck. Quick list from their security team: 1) they require HSM-backed CMKs for all audit logs, 2) cross-account role for Firehose to deliver logs to their SIEM account, 3) explicit egress locks for telemetry (only IPs in allowlist). tagging this thread for blockers + renewal-risk monitoring. @Devraj @Priya
Devraj: ack. HSM-backed keys are supported via our KMS-HSM integration but need customer KMS ARN and an HSM attestation doc. Can we ask them for the AWS CloudHSM cluster id?
midtown-it: we have a cluster id and an internal attestation PDF. also they want rotation every 180 days and strict key-use tags: `env:prod`,`team:security`.
Priya: rotation 180 days fine. We'll require a key policy that limits Decrypt/GenerateDataKey to our service role and their VPC endpoint. I'll paste a sanitized example.
Priya: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodToUse",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-priv-forwarder"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com","kms:EncryptionContext:env": "prod"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Theo: Firehose => their SIEM account: we should create a minimal assume-role with only `firehose:PutRecord` permissions. Recommend short-lived STS sessions. Sample trust policy below.
Theo: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/midtown-firehose"},
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```
Devraj: networking: they want egress pinned to three collector IPs (34.200.12.8/29). We'll open 443 outbound only and require TLS 1.2+. They also asked whether our shipper supports mTLS. Answer: our on-prem forwarder supports client certs; hosted forwarder uses TLS with strict cert validation.
midtown-it: requirement: audit logs must arrive with SSE-KMS and the KMS must be customer HSM-backed. also retention 2 years.
Lina: flagged renewal-risk: if critical infra blockers >2 at EOD we propose accelerated remediation hours (credit) and notify AM. capture blockers below.
Priya: blockers so far: 1) HSM attestation doc pending (midtown action). 2) Their S3 bucket policy needs `kms:Encrypt` allowed to our role (we provided template but not applied). 3) Firewall rule requires security team's approval due to IP changes (midtown internal). that's 3 -> risk open.
midtown-it: we'll push the attestation by noon. S3 policy change is queued but may take 24h. Firewall change needs change window — earliest tomorrow.
Theo: action items:
- Theo: prepare assume-role Terraform snippet + minimal IAM policy (ETA today 3pm PT)
- Priya: finalize HSM-backed KMS policy with tag enforcement + rotation note (ETA tomorrow)
- Devraj: draft firewall change request template + run local shipper mTLS config guide (ETA today)
- Lina: set renewal-risk flag in CRM and tentatively schedule emergency eng-hours block if blockers persist at EOD
ops-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.company/runbooks/midtown-health-onboard. Deployment status: KMS: AWAITING-ATTESTATION, IAM: TEMPLATE-PREP, NETWORK: CHANGE-PENDING
midtown-it: one quick Q: can logs be delivered via Kinesis or only S3? we prefer Kinesis for streaming to Splunk.
Theo: we support both. For Kinesis we need IAM policy `kinesis:PutRecords` and we recommend VPC endpoints for kinesis. We'll add a Kinesis snippet to the runbook.
Lina: also capture quick feedback points for post-onboard survey: clarity of HSM docs, speed of IAM templates, ability to meet change window. please add any other pain points.
Priya: I'll note that customers often want a prefilled S3 bucket policy we can apply on their behalf to speed cutover. consider adding that to the onboarding checklist.
Devraj: internal note: if attestation is late past EOD escalate to security PM.
Lina: ok leaving thread open. ping me if any task slips. thanks team :heart:
